Over the past few years, we have experienced volatility in steel prices due to supplier consolidation, tight mill orders due to a pandemic, the war in Ukraine and tariffs on foreign steel. Our manufacturing facilities further benefit from the flexibility to move between direct versus tolling services based on demand throughout the year. We operate 28 manufacturing facilities located in the U.S. (19), Canada (2), China, India, Germany, and Mexico (4).
